### 2026-10-18 – Sat October 17:

**2h**

Sat October 17:

Today I researched a lot of Onshape techniques and learnt many new skills to help make the marble run easier. One specific technique I learnt was the helix tool, which will allow me to make spiral paths, which was one of the main points of my idea. I also decided to make the landing pad of the jump a separate part, which will allow me to slide and adjust its position later on depending on where it lands and its speed. Also, I made the marble.
